summary: Green Plains Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to its existing senior secured sustainability-linked revolving credit facility. The Second Revolver Amendment extends the termination date from March 25, 2027 to September 25, 2027 and reduces the facility commitment from $350 million to $300 million. No new borrowing, special distribution, or extraordinary corporate event is disclosed. This is a standard credit facility modification, not a special situation.
